title: CorteXforge: Scenario-Based RF Dataset Generation on Real Testbeds
abstract: arXiv:2610.26999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning for radio frequency (RF) signal analysis relies on large annotated datasets, yet synthetic datasets trade physical realism for controllability, while uncontrolled over-theair measurements offer realism but limited reproducibility. We present CorteXforge, a scenario-based framework for generating realistic and reproducible RF datasets on programmable software defined radio (SDR) testbeds. High-level RF scenarios are automatically translated into synchronized experiments executed on the SLICES-RI/CorteXlab platform, producing fully annotated Signal Metadata Format (SIGMF) datasets that capture hardware impairments and propagation effects. We validate CorteXforge through automatic modulation classification using ModForge, an over-the-air (OTA) dataset generated with the framework. translated_title: CorteXforge：基于真实测试平台的场景化射频数据集生成
translated_abstract: 用于射频信号分析的深度学习依赖于大型标注数据集，然而合成数据集以牺牲物理真实性来换取可控性，而不受控的空中测量虽具有真实性但可重复性有限。我们提出了CorteXforge，这是一个基于场景的框架，用于在可编程软件定义无线电测试平台上生成真实且可重复的射频数据集。高层射频场景被自动转换为在SLICES-RI/CorteXlab平台上执行的同步实验，生成完整标注的信号元数据格式数据集，这些数据集捕捉了硬件损伤和传播效应。我们通过使用ModForge（一个利用该框架生成的空中数据集）进行自动调制分类来验证CorteXforge。跨域实验揭示了合成到真实的性能差距，并表明合成数据预训练对于适应真实空中数据仍然有益。
tldr: CorteXforge是一个基于场景的框架，能够在真实SDR测试平台上自动生成真实且可重复的射频数据集，实验揭示了合成数据与真实数据之间的性能差距，同时证明合成数据预训练有助于模型适应真实空中测量数据。
en_tdlr: CorteXforge is a scenario-based framework that automatically generates realistic and reproducible RF datasets on real SDR testbeds; cross-domain experiments reveal a synthetic-to-real performance gap while demonstrating that synthetic pretraining remains beneficial for adaptation to OTA data.
